title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: OCR extracts text from images for AI analysis
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's documentation supports automatic OCR, the billing requirements, investigation access boundaries and the listed controls. The roadmap facts match, and the briefing appropriately reports the different format lists and the unresolved relationship with tenant-level OCR. The cited pages opened successfully during this check.
